payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 7:5–12 as prayer inside israel’s story evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Samuel’s intercession occurs with confession, sacrifice, enemy advance, thunder, pursuit, and memorial; the scene assigns several agents without reducing the outcome to one human act.
